products.name: SenseTime SenseChat
products.note: Chinese multimodal LLM; computer vision integration; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
SenseTime is an artificial intelligence company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Hong Kong. The company describes itself as building SenseNova native multimodal large language models and SenseCore AI cloud infrastructure, with a stated focus on enterprise AI digital transformation across diverse industries.

According to IDC's "China AI Software Market Semi-Annual Tracker, 2025 H2" report, cited on the company's own site, SenseTime has led China's Vision AI market share for ten consecutive years. The company's tracked product is SenseChat, a Chinese multimodal LLM with computer vision integration, for which cross-border data review is advised.
